title: PRISM/A — C: Components
description: Services, UIs, workers, AI models, adapters, and platforms within domains. One file per domain or landscape.

components.description: All deployable or logical units within the application landscape.

artifact_type.description: Component type. service = long-running workload; ui = client interface; worker = background job; ai_model = ML/LLM/agentic system; adapter = anti-corruption layer or external facade; platform = vendor-managed SaaS.

domain_id.description: The domain this component belongs to. Required — every component must be owned by a domain.

description.description: What this component does and its role in the domain.

tech_stack.description: Key technologies, languages, frameworks, and runtimes.

system_type.description: AI/ML specialization. Only relevant for artifact_type: ai_model.

trigger_mode.description: How this component is invoked or activated.

data_sensitivity.description: Data sensitivity categories handled by this component.

compliance_frameworks.description: Compliance frameworks this component must satisfy.

prism_ea_system.description: Cross-reference to the PRISM EA Reality layer system ID that corresponds to this component.

prism_i_artifact.description: Cross-reference to a PRISM Intent artifact (goal, driver, or constraint) that motivates this component.

depends_on.description: Component IDs this component depends on. Used for blast radius analysis.
